sentences.text: Dr. Hana Sato committed to circulating the draft amendment by the end of the month, so it is due at the end of November.

citations.quote: I'll circulate the draft amendment by the end of the month.

sentences.text: The amendment is a substantial protocol amendment, which Dr. Sato offered to draft.

citations.quote: Yes, a substantial amendment. I can draft it.

answer.gaps: The meeting excerpts give no explicit date for the meeting itself, so the end of the month is placed as November only from the meeting's title (Nov).

sentences.text: The October meeting set four action items with a deadline: Sam Okafor's site agreements by the twenty-fourth, Dr. Hana Sato's patient listings by Friday, Priya Nair's audit plan within two weeks, and Marcus Lindqvist's timeline and risk register before the next meeting.

citations.quote: I'll have both agreements out for signature by the twenty-fourth.
send them to the committee by Friday
have a plan to you within two weeks
circulate both before the next meeting

sentences.text: The November meeting confirms Sam's site agreements as done: both were signed on the twenty-second, two days early.

citations.quote: Both backup site agreements were signed on the twenty-second, two days early.

sentences.text: The November meeting confirms Hana's listings as done: Elena said the data monitoring committee reviewed the listings Hana sent.

citations.quote: The data monitoring committee reviewed the listings Hana sent.

sentences.text: The November meeting confirms Priya's audit plan as done: Priya said it went to Dana on the fourth.

citations.quote: The audit plan went to Dana on the fourth.

sentences.text: The November meeting confirms Marcus's update as done: he said the timeline and risk register went out on the tenth.

citations.quote: I've updated the timeline and the risk register, they went out on the tenth.

sentences.text: Sam's other October item, sending the notice letter to Quellmark once Priya confirmed the audit dates, had no fixed deadline. The November meeting confirms he sent it on the fourth.

citations.quote: I'll send the notice letter once Priya confirms the audit dates.
Sam sent the notice letter to Quellmark the same day

answer.gaps: Neither meeting gives its date, so the deadlines can't be placed exactly. Only Sam's item is explicitly confirmed as on time (two days early); for Hana's, Priya's and Marcus's items the November meeting confirms completion but not whether the deadline was met.
